const d = $input.first().json;
const prompt = `You are a product intelligence analyst writing a weekly digest for a Director of Product at a CIAM company (Ping Identity).

Week: ${d.week}
Findings this week (${d.findings_count} total):
${JSON.stringify(d.findings.slice(0,20))}

System health: ${d.error_count} errors this week.

Write a newsletter with these sections using markdown formatting:

## BIGGEST MOVES THIS WEEK
2-3 bullets (use - prefix): Company — what changed — why it matters

## RISKS
Only confidence 4-5; skip section entirely if none.

## OPPORTUNITIES
Only confidence 4-5; skip section entirely if none.

## ONE STRATEGIC THEME TO WATCH
One paragraph.

## RECOMMENDED ACTIONS
1-2 max, use - prefix for each.

## SYSTEM HEALTH
One line.

Rules: Plain English. No jargon. No padding. Max 600 words. If quiet week, say so. Label low-confidence items as [LOW CONFIDENCE]. Always use ## for section headers and - for bullet points.`;
return [{ json: { ...d, prompt } }];

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'claude-sonnet-4-6', max_tokens: 2048, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}
